actual_changes: Added a small PowerShell WinForms controller showing AUTO MODE, scheduler/task state, poll/run timestamps, retry count, blocked state, and retry time.

Added current-user Task Scheduler install, enable, disable, check-once, log-open, and uninstall actions; the intended task is disabled after install and runs watcher.ps1 -Once every five minutes only while enabled.
Extended watcher state with controller-readable timestamps/status and enforced at most two five-minute-backoff retries per fingerprint before BLOCKED.
Added single-archive 2 MiB log rotation, targeting about 4 MiB total watcher logs.
Documented behavior, safety profile, install, operation, and uninstall.
Watcher now prefers the complete Git for Windows executable at C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe and uses its HTTPS helper when present.

scheduler_mechanism_interval: Current-user interactive limited-privilege task named Crystal Agent Watcher; five-minute repetition; each invocation uses watcher.ps1 -Once; disabled by default; WakeToRun false.
default_auto_mode: OFF in installer design; live scheduled task not installed
enable_disable_behavior: Enable toggles only the named task. Disable disables it and attempts to stop only PowerShell whose command line contains the exact repository watcher path.
retry_cap_backoff: One initial attempt plus at most two automatic retries for the same fingerprint, each separated by at least five minutes; then BLOCKED / NEEDS REVIEW.
log_cap: watcher.log plus watcher.log.1, each approximately capped at 2 MiB; target total approximately 4 MiB.
